motivation.source_anomaly: block2 reached diagnostic T=33 with owner uncharge31 and no classified target drain
motivation.question: Can normal host activity consume or mutate verified target memcg stock without an injected slot-pressure stressor?

setup: target performs zero touches during ambient window

owner_q64.purpose: final boundary measurement and unexpected ambient Q64 detection

required: kprobe_profile deltas for every active critical probe
complete PRE/POST transaction markers during setup and final diagnostic

drain_stock.reason: drain_stock cannot be owner-memcg filtered directly and global ordinary event logging may add unnecessary load on a daily-use host
drain_stock.future_use: short qualified snapshot windows or an independently qualified low-rate attribution scheme

stop_or_hold_conditions: VmPTE growth in measured canary touches
critical probe missed delta != 0 or unavailable

classification.direct_drain_rule: isolated attributed drain d, matching owner uncharge d, 0<d<=31, and final T == 64-d
classification.direct_consume_rule: isolated successful owner consume c, 0<c<=31, and final T == 64-c
classification.stable_rule: complete zero-miss observation, no drain/consume/refill/uncharge signal, and final T=64
classification.ambient_q64_rule: any owner Q64 during the zero-target-touch ambient window is a state reset and blocks simple final-boundary arithmetic
classification.unknown_rule: preserve complete observations that do not satisfy an exact known fingerprint
